precommitted_local_invariant.rule: For candidate event e, deterministically process e against the local evidence automaton to obtain q_after and deferred-effects metadata. Classify e as erasable nuisance N iff q_after=q_before, no evidence bit performs 0->1 or 1->0, and e creates no deferred state capable of later changing any evidence bit. Any nonzero changed-bit mask, any deferred bit effect, any attempted bit clear, or incomplete observability yields NON_N or UNKNOWN-retain, never N.

precommitted_local_invariant.pre_finality_guard: An s transition is admissible only when authoritative F already holds and singleton evidence is authoritative at/after F; otherwise retain as invalid/UNKNOWN rather than promote to s.
